summary: "Danzn Guyz & Galz" is a monthly drop-in social ballroom dance at the Weaverville Community Center, led continuously by local resident Reneé Twilley (a ballroom dancer since 1995) since at least January 2023 through the 2026 listings in our dataset. Each session opens with a short lesson in a rotating dance style (waltz, bachata, etc.) followed by open social dancing, and interested attendees are told to email Reneé directly for updates, suggesting a recurring regular crowd rather than a one-off class audience.

evidence.note: Listing names a specific group leader (Reneé Twilley, by email) and describes a drop-in lesson-then-social-dance format that rotates monthly dance styles, run at a community center rather than a business.

Town of Weaverville page names the group "Danzn Guyz & Galz" leading the dance parties, confirms Reneé Twilley champions the event, and notes it is drop-in with no membership fee but partners/no age restrictions and direct email sign-up for updates.

Weaverville Center for Creative & Healthy Living program listing shows the same Reneé Twilley-led social ballroom dance running since January 2023, indicating multi-year continuity of the same leader and format rather than a single scraped event.

A search result also surfaces Reneé Twilley performing a Viennese Waltz at a DanceWNC showcase, consistent with her being a recognized figure in the regional ballroom dance community rather than a hired instructor for a one-off class.
